item.title: [DE|Local] BR24 Thema des Tages (Bayern) (Wed 17:51): Eine Mordserie und viele offene Fragen: 15 Jahre Selbstenttarnung NSU
item.description:
Originally published Wed 04 Nov 2026 17:51 IST.
Genau 15 Jahre ist es her, dass die Aufklärung einer Mordserie die Schlagzeilen beherrschte. Jahrelang hatte die Terrorgruppe Nationalsozialistischer Untergrund unentdeckt Rauberüberfälle verübt, Sprengstoffanschläge durchgeführt und Menschen umgebracht. Noch immer gibt es viele offene Fragen und die Aufarbeitung ist nicht abgeschlossen.

item.title: [EN|In-Depth] BBC Global News Podcast (Wed 18:36): Democrats storm to success in US midterm elections
item.description:
Originally published Wed 04 Nov 2026 18:36 IST.

Democrats have stormed to success in the US midterm elections, capitalising on voter anger about the Iran war, the economy and threats to democracy under Donald Trump. Both the Senate and the House have been flipped by a wide margin. Senate seats turned from Republican to Democrat in Texas, Ohio, Iowa, Kansas and Maine, as well as North and South Carolina. Many of the seats had been held by Republicans for decades. In a first reaction, Iran's supreme leader said he doesn't expect US policy to change, although his chief negotiator earlier said the results showed Americans didn't want war. Also; Israel's president has begun consultations with party leaders on who can form a government after last week's inconclusive vote, and President Zelensky has given Ukraine's highest civilian award for women to the American first lady, Melania Trump, for a ceasefire which she's credited with brokering in the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky.
